explication: OpenAEV is a cyber adversary simulation platform: teams plan and run exercises, deliver injects through integrations, and review execution outcomes and security coverage. The API exposes campaign, workflow, autonomous-run, and attack-path capabilities; ingestion services build attack-path execution and finding data. Security coverage can be exchanged with OpenCTI, and connector orchestration manages connector instances. The sampled sources also show notification processing, full-text search, and coverage-send job handling. Several capabilities are evident from the README and tree, but unsampled implementation details do not establish their internal call wiring.
